data.title: Bay Grove Residences
data.about:
Set in the heart of Dubai Islands, Bay Grove Residences by Nakheel presents a rare opportunity to embrace waterfront living at its finest. This final release of Phase 4 introduces four elegantly designed residential towers, offering a mix of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and an exclusive 4-bedroom penthouse. With sweeping sea views, vibrant podium gardens, and refined interiors, the project redefines modern luxury by the sea.

Crafted for resort-style coastal living, the residences combine privacy with community energy. Residents enjoy direct access to the promenade and premium shared spaces, such as infinity pools, a stylish clubhouse, outdoor fitness areas, and landscaped paths. Developed by Nakheel — one of Dubai’s most visionary developers — Bay Grove Residences reflects architectural sophistication, unbeatable amenities, and attractive pricing, making it a compelling lifestyle and investment choice.

characteristics_module.title: Bay Grove Residences by Nakheel – Seaside Living in a Landmark Waterfront Location
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Resort-Style Coastal Living – Enjoy infinity pools, private beach access, and a serene promenade right outside your home.
  • Prime Waterfront Location – Situated in Dubai Islands, minutes from the mainland and city’s top destinations.
  • Developed by Nakheel – A trusted name behind iconic developments, including Dubai Islands and Palm Jumeirah.
  • Modern Architecture – Curved balconies, sand-toned lines, and floor-to-ceiling windows maximize light and sea views.
  • Clubhouse and Entertainment Spaces – Socialize or unwind in a dedicated clubhouse, cinema room, and BBQ areas.
  • Family-Friendly Lifestyle – Kids’ clubs, indoor/outdoor play areas, and landscaped podiums support all age groups.
  • Attractive Pricing – Competitive starting prices and flexible payment plans for investors and end-users alike.
  • Spacious Floor Plans – Choose from generously sized 1 to 4-bedroom units and a unique penthouse.

image.name: Bay Grove Dubai Apartments by Nakheel

location_tile.title: A Tranquil Island Address, Close to the City
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Bay Grove Residences is located on Island B of Dubai Islands — a prime waterfront location with easy access to the city via Infinity Bridge and the new access bridge. Just north of the mainland, the development is minutes from Sheikh Zayed Road and close to Dubai’s iconic shopping, dining, and cultural districts. With stunning beaches, golf spaces, and parks nearby, this natural haven offers a rare balance between seclusion and convenience.

  • 20 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
  • 22 Minutes - The Dubai Frame
  • 24 Minutes - Dubai World Trade Centre
  • 24 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 33 Minutes - Business Bay
